steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP (blender-mcp add-on, port 9876)
actions: Imported assets/skaters/nia/raw/nia-tripo.glb with the glTF importer.
Removed the Tripo empties (Node_0, node_0, RootNode) and kept the world transform of the armature.
Scaled the armature and the mesh by 1.7384 (0.978 m to 1.700 m) and applied the location, the rotation, and the scale.
Checked that the wheels touch z = 0 and that the model faces -Y in Blender (+Z in glTF).
Kept the Mixamo rig (65 mixamorig: joints) and the skin weights. The mesh was not decimated, because it had 17,896 triangles.
Resized the textures: base color 4096 to 2048, normal 2048 to 1024, metallic-roughness 2048 PNG to 1024 JPEG. All JPEG, quality 88.
Set the specular tint to white, so that the exporter writes no KHR_materials_specular. KHR_materials_volume and FB_ngon_encoding are not written.
Exported a GLB with Draco (level 6; quantization: position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12), no animations.
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb, 2,123,152 bytes, 17,896 triangles, 1 skinned mesh, 65 joints, 1.700 m tall, extensions: KHR_draco_mesh_compression only
local_files_not_in_git: assets/skaters/nia/raw/nia-nodraco.glb (the same export without Draco, 3,732,876 bytes, for Cascadeur)

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP, script scripts/blender/nia_clips.py
actions: Keyed 15 clips by hand in Python on the Mixamo rig: idle, push, coast, carve_left, carve_right, jump, air_trick_1 (grab), air_trick_2 (split), grind, manual, bail, dance_1 to dance_4.
Leg IK (pole angle 0) and a copy-rotation on each foot held the wheels on the ground. Each clip was baked to bone keys at 30 fps, and the IK helpers were removed.
Removed the curves that stay at the rest pose (8,945 curves). Set the baked keys to linear.
Exported with Draco and the same mesh and texture settings as M1-01, with all actions as glTF animations.
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb, 2,290,112 bytes, 17,896 triangles, 65 joints, 15 animations (13 to 21 channels each)
local_files_not_in_git: assets/skaters/nia/raw/nia-nodraco.glb (the animated export without Draco, 3,899,844 bytes)

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP, script scripts/blender/nia_clips.py
steps.issue: M1-02 (#12), second pass after the user playtest
actions: Replaced the clip set with 20 clips in Atlanta rink style (free skate) and X Games style (rails and air). The sources are in docs/characters/skate-style-references.md.

Free skate: idle, push (ATL stride), coast, ride_back, carve_left, carve_right (Cross Step). Air: jump, land, air_mute, air_japan, air_liukang. Rails: grind_frontside, grind_soul, grind_unity, manual. Fail: bail. Style: dance_prep, dance_crisscross, dance_spin, dance_sitspin.
Keyed the groove clips at 24 frames per beat. Turned the knee pole targets with the hips for the rail stances.
Removed the curves that stay at the rest pose (11,665 curves). Exported with the same Draco, mesh, and texture settings.
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb, 2,427,940 bytes, 17,896 triangles, 65 joints, 20 animations (18 to 24 channels each)

steps.step: Third pass: the push stroke goes diagonally out and back, and the arms swing in a sine wave with shoulder turn. The other 19 clips are rebaked with no change.

Fourth pass: a new idle (hand on the hip, toe tap), and four new dances (Bankhead Bounce, Walk It Out, Swag Surf, Snap Lean). The Prep, crisscross, and the spins are retimed to whole beats. 24 animations.
Fifth pass: the coast is now the ATL ride glide, one bar, with a scissor stance, a dip on each beat, and shoulder rolls.

steps.command: npx @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 resize assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb --width 1024 --height 1024 && npx @gltf-transform/cli@4.1.1 draco assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb --quantize-position 14 --quantize-normal 10 --quantize-texcoord 12 --quantize-generic 12
actions: Made the phone variant (#74): the base color texture from 2048 px to 1024 px. The normal and roughness maps were already 1024 px; the tool encoded them again as JPEG.
The resize decoded the Draco meshes. The draco command compressed them again with the M1-01 quantization (position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12). It also welded identical vertices.
No new generation and no credits. The mesh, the rig, the joint names, and the 24 clips are the same as skater.glb (src/render/skater-model.test.js checks them).
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb, 1,598,396 bytes (skater.glb is 2,735,736 bytes), the same triangles, joints, and clips

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (background mode), scripts/blender/skater_runtime.py (nia_clips.py with the forward IK), skater_motion_retarget.py, skater_texture_variant.py
steps.prompt: Rebuild all clips on the v2 body. Drop the legacy clip transfer. Use the knee-pole and twist fixes of skater_forward_motion.py for every clip.
steps.command: blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_runtime.py -- --name nia; blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_motion_retarget.py -- --name nia --fbx assets/skaters/nia/raw/tripo-motion-v1/tripo_convert_8a663486-9228-4e65-abc7-9c14db3df2dd.fbx --out assets/skaters/nia/raw/runtime-v2 --base assets/skaters/nia/raw/runtime-v2/nia-runtime.blend --preserve-actions --clip dance_smoothquad --glb assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb --blend assets/skaters/nia/raw/runtime-v2/nia-runtime.blend; blender -b --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 -P scripts/blender/skater_texture_variant.py -- --in assets/skaters/nia/raw/runtime-v2/nia-runtime.blend --out assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb
actions: Started from raw/forward-v2/nia-forward.blend: the corrected v2 body with the reviewed push and coast clips.
Removed the 22 legacy clips that runtime v1 appended from the old review rig.

Keyed 22 clips of nia_clips.py on the v2 rig: calibrated knee pole angles {'L': 24, 'R': -10}, knee poles that turn with the foot yaw, quaternion foot targets, and at() foot x scaled by hip width (stance 1.000).
At each of 240 leg keys, turned the knee pole about the hip-ankle axis until the knee bend points over the skate (largest residual 0.01 degrees).
Fists curl each finger about its own axis (finger direction crossed with the palm normal).
Retargeted dance_smoothquad from the approved Tripo smooth quad dance (no new credits). Same source as runtime v1.

motions.prompt: A quad roller skater dances the Atlanta Laffy Taffy groove in place: a relaxed knee bounce on each beat, smooth shoulder rolls, and loose arm swings, upbeat and friendly.
A quad roller skater glides forward with bent knees, then does smooth crossover steps to turn left, the right skate crossing over the left, arms out for balance, then glides out of the turn.

steps.tool: scripts/assets/compress-skaters.mjs on Node 24 with @gltf-transform/core, extensions, and functions 4.5.1, draco3dgltf 1.5.9, sharp 0.35.5 (installed with npm i --no-save, not in package.json)
steps.prompt: Cut the skater download: the two skater GLBs were 75% of the low/toon download and 69% of the phone/toon download.
steps.command: node scripts/assets/compress-skaters.mjs assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb --quality 85 --normal-quality 90 && node scripts/assets/compress-skaters.mjs assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb --quality 80 --normal-quality 85
actions: Textures: JPEG to WebP (EXT_texture_webp, required), the same pixel sizes. skater.glb: quality 85, normal maps 90. skater-1024.glb: quality 80, normal maps 85.

Clips: resampled with tolerance 1e-4 (keys on a straight line removed), rotation keys stored as normalized int16. The largest change from the old clips, sampled at the old key times: 0.18 degrees of rotation and 0.45 mm of translation. The 25 clip names and all channels are the same.
Meshes: Draco again (edgebreaker; quantization position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12). The same triangles; Draco merged a few duplicate vertices.

No new generation and no credits. The mesh, the rig, the joint names, and the clips are the same (src/render/skater-model.test.js). The before and after five views and face close-up match (PSNR 45 dB or more).
steps.result: skater.glb 6,306,628 to 2,210,000 bytes; skater-1024.glb 5,420,932 to 1,755,420 bytes

steps.tool: scripts/assets/recolor-skater.mjs (recipe nia-navy) on Node 22 with sharp 0.35.5 (installed with npm i --no-save, not in package.json)
steps.prompt: Nia's dark green pants merge with the BeltLine lawn (art direction #159, docs/art-direction-pbr.md section 6). The owner chose navy for the pants. Keep the orange jacket, the cream boots and the warm wheels.
steps.command: node scripts/assets/recolor-skater.mjs assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb --recipe nia-navy --quality 84 && node scripts/assets/recolor-skater.mjs assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb assets/skaters/nia/skater-1024.glb --recipe nia-navy --quality 80
actions: Joggers: forest green (texture mean sRGB 51,74,44) to navy #2E3D6B (HSV 225 deg, 0.57, 0.42). A texel changes when its hue is 80 to 125 deg, its saturation 0.22 or more and its value 36 to 95, with soft ramps at the edges. The new color keeps the linear luminance pattern of the old texel, so the folds, seams and stitches stay.

Six base color images change: tripo_part_1, 2, 15, 16 (the joggers) and tripo_part_8, 9 (the pant cuffs on the boot texture). An image changes only when the joggers color covers 5% or more of it, so the hair, the face and the green wristband (hue 135 to 145 deg, brighter) stay byte for byte.
WebP quality 84 for skater.glb (85 made the file 3 KB bigger) and 80 for skater-1024.glb, as in #187.
The other 60 images, the Draco mesh, the rig, the 25 clips and the glTF JSON (but the buffer view offsets) are byte for byte the same.
Kept: the orange jacket, the cream top, knee pads and boots, the gold wheels, the peach toe stops, the green wristband.
No new generation and no credits.
